content.short: Smart Contract Audit Token (SCAT DAO) provides community-funded security audits for Cardano projects.
content.description: Smart Contract Audit Token (SCAT DAO) is a decentralized autonomous organization on Cardano dedicated to enhancing ecosystem security. The platform uses its native $AUDIT token for governance, allowing community members to vote on which projects should receive independent security audits. By using a community-managed treasury to fund these audits, SCAT DAO eliminates the common conflict of interest found in traditional models where projects pay for their own reviews. Their mission is to provide unbiased, high-quality security reports that protect investors and users alike.
content.meta: SCAT DAO offers community-funded Cardano smart contract audits to enhance ecosystem security. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
